summary:
家得寶 EPS 符合預期（+0.69%）、營收年增 4.8%，盤後幾乎持平，23.3 倍本益比合理，房市復甦帶動需求但成長動能仍有限。
• EPS $3.43 超越預估 $3.41，驚喜幅度僅 +0.69%，屬符合預期水準，無明顯驚喜。
• 單季營收 $417.7 億美元，年增 4.8%，房市交易量低迷下成長動能受限。
• 本益比 23.3 倍，市值 $3,274 億美元，對景氣循環零售股屬合理估值，安全邊際較好。
• 盤後股價幾乎持平（+0.06%），市場定調為「如期」財報，缺乏推動力。
• 4.8% 年增率反映房市交易量受高利率壓抑，大型翻修項目支出是相對穩定的需求支柱。
ai_view:
家得寶本季財報屬「基本達標、無驚喜」類型——0.69% EPS 驚喜與 4.8% 年增率均在市場預期範圍內，盤後持平印證無動能存在。23.3 倍本益比在大型零售股中相對合理，提供基本的估值保護。家得寶的核心投資邏輯與利率週期高度掛鉤：一旦聯準會降息使抵押貸款利率回落至 5.5% 以下，房市交易量預期回升，大型翻修需求將帶動業績加速。短期而言，在利率未明顯下行前，股價動能有限；中期而言，若降息週期確立，家得寶是最直接的受惠標的之一。需追蹤指標：美國 30 年期抵押貸款利率走勢、既有住宅銷售量月度變化、同店銷售客單價趨勢、以及大客戶（承包商）業務佔比成長。對正在布局降息受惠標的的投資人，家得寶是本批次中最值得列入觀察清單的標的，但當前時點啟動前需等待更明確的利率政策訊號。

需留意：美國房市交易量持續受 30 年期房貸利率 6-7% 壓制，若利率未能下行，家得寶的核心需求將繼續受限。；消費者對大型翻修項目的支出意願受通膨與不確定性影響，若一般家庭財務壓力上升，可選性消費首先削減。；供應鏈正常化後大宗商品（木材、鋼材）價格若再度上漲，將影響毛利率水準。

summary_en:
Home Depot barely beat EPS by 0.69% with a modest 4.8% YoY revenue growth; a flat post-earnings reaction and 23.3x P/E reflect a stable but low-growth environment for home improvement retail.
• EPS of $3.43 barely beat the $3.41 estimate by 0.69%—essentially an in-line result with no meaningful upside.
• Quarterly revenue of $41.77B grew 4.8% YoY, reflecting subdued home improvement spending amid elevated mortgage rates.
• P/E of 23.3x on a $327B market cap is a reasonable valuation for a cyclical retailer with strong free cash flow generation.
• Post-earnings stock was nearly flat at +0.06%, confirming an in-line result with no catalyst for price movement.
• 4.8% YoY growth reflects housing market headwinds; large-project remodeling demand remains a relatively stable offset.

ai_view_en:
Home Depot's quarter was stable and unsurprising—a 0.69% EPS beat and 4.8% growth confirm the business is holding steady without providing any new positive momentum. The 23.3x P/E is a defensible multiple that offers basic valuation protection. Home Depot's core investment thesis is directly tied to the interest rate cycle: when 30-year mortgage rates fall below 5.5%, housing turnover is expected to recover significantly, accelerating large-project remodeling demand. Near-term, without a clear rate relief catalyst, stock momentum remains limited. Medium-term, if a rate cut cycle materializes, Home Depot is among the most direct beneficiaries in the retail sector. Key metrics to monitor: US 30-year mortgage rate trajectory, existing home sales monthly data, comparable store average ticket trend, and pro contractor business proportion growth. A rate-cycle play worth monitoring, but await a clearer rate policy signal before initiating positions.

Watch：US housing transaction volume remains suppressed by elevated 30-year mortgage rates (6-7%); without rate relief, Home Depot's core demand driver remains constrained.; Consumer willingness to undertake large remodeling projects is sensitive to inflation and financial stress; discretionary home improvement is the first spending category cut.; If commodity prices (lumber, steel) re-escalate post-supply chain normalization, gross margins could face renewed pressure.
beat_or_miss: 符合預期 EPS 實際 $3.43 略超預估 $3.41，驚喜幅度 +0.69%，實質上符合預期。
